wire.t: Texans 26, Colts 3 on Thursday night. C.J. Stroud went 21 of 27 for 194 yards and three touchdowns (26.96 for Jefferson’s Reserve), David Montgomery ran 26 times for 107 yards (16.9 for OBJAY), and Nico Collins caught a 42-yard touchdown (14.3 for The Champ). Jonathan Taylor ran 11 times for 21 yards (5.2 for Kraft for Cash).

Daniel Jones went 12 of 27 for 144 yards with an interception and was sacked for a safety. That's 4.06 points for Asian Jim. Shane Steichen, asked if Jones stays the starter: "We'll evaluate everything."

Baker Mayfield (foot, right thumb) upgraded to limited participation Thursday after sitting Wednesday. Tampa Bay won't name a Week 11 starter until at least Friday. Mayfield is on Catfan94’s Farm Team's bench; Jalon Daniels is on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte's bench.

TheMoneyTeam2302 added Colts receiver Laquon Treadwell to Hold My DK at 6:42 PM ET Thursday, started him at receiver, and got 0.0. Tyler Warren, on the Hold My DK taxi squad, scored 3.7 in the same game. Dude, Your Getting a Dell leads Hold My DK 10.1 to 0.0.
ZachCarroll09 dropped running back Demond Claiborne from I Chase Brown Kids Thursday morning without a corresponding add.

Thursday practice: Kenneth Walker III (Catfan94’s Farm Team) missed a second straight day. Brock Bowers (LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix), Mike Evans (Jefferson’s Reserve) and Darren Waller (Hold My DK) were upgraded to limited. Bhayshul Tuten (Jefferson’s Reserve) went from limited to non-participant.

Geno Smith was limited again for OBJAY and Dalton Kincaid wasn't seen at practice. Jake Ferguson has been ruled out for Kraft for Cash. Kyler Murray missed Wednesday and Thursday for Asian Jim, and Ladd McConkey was limited both days.
As of Friday morning, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is the only team in the league with a bye-week player in its starting lineup: Drake Maye, at quarterback.

stories.title: Texans 26, Colts 3: Stroud bails out Jefferson’s Reserve, Daniel Jones sinks Asian Jim, and Drake Maye is still my quarterback
stories.dek: Dude, Your Getting a Dell is winning a fantasy game for the first time all week, Hold My DK started a guy it picked up 93 minutes before kickoff, and Baker Mayfield practiced.
body: Houston beat Indianapolis 26-3 and the fantasy damage got handed out unevenly. C.J. Stroud threw three touchdowns and banked 26.96 for Jefferson’s Reserve, so jmello16 is up 26.96 to 0.0 on Bourbon Lover before Sunday. David Montgomery ran 26 times for 107 yards, 16.9 for OBJAY, while Jonathan Taylor ran 11 times for 21 yards, 5.2 for Kraft for Cash. JAY2913 leads BTaylor1 16.9 to 5.2 and I moved that line from 16.0 to 10.5.

Daniel Jones went 12 of 27 for 144 yards with a pick and a safety. That's 4.06 points from the quarterback slot for Asian Jim, who were already 26.5-point dogs to Catfan94’s Farm Team and are now 30.0-point dogs. Shane Steichen said "We'll evaluate everything" when asked about Jones. ManicOrientals has been evaluating everything since Kyler Murray went down, and the answer keeps being Tyler Shough.

Best transaction of the night: TheMoneyTeam2302 grabbed Laquon Treadwell at 6:42 PM, plugged him in at receiver with Drake London and Cooper Kupp on bye, and got 0.0. Tyler Warren was sitting on the Hold My DK taxi squad and scored 3.7 in the same game. So as of Friday morning, Dude, Your Getting a Dell leads Hold My DK 10.1 to 0.0. Br0phy, screenshot it. Frame it. It's not going to last.

And me. Baker Mayfield upgraded to limited on Thursday, which is bad news for my $11 Jalon Daniels plan, and Tampa Bay decides Friday at the earliest. Meanwhile I'm the only manager in the league with a bye-week player in his starting lineup, and that player is Drake Maye, at quarterback. Ashton Dulin gave me 4.5 last night. The Champ is up 14.3 to 4.5 and the line is 44.0. I'll fix the lineup. Probably. Justin Fields plays Sunday too, and I'm told that counts.

stories.title: Thursday practice report: Walker misses again, Bowers and Evans get back on the field
stories.dek: Friday's designations come out this afternoon. Here's what Thursday's practices mean for the five games left this week.
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team: Kenneth Walker III missed practice Wednesday and Thursday and he's still in jrsmith1391's starting lineup. Baker Mayfield was limited Thursday, but he's on the bench behind Brock Purdy and Breece Hall at superflex, so that's a Tampa Bay problem, not a Catfan94’s Farm Team problem. Line moved to 30.0 over Asian Jim because Daniel Jones already scored 4.06.

Jefferson’s Reserve: Mike Evans went from no practice to limited. Bhayshul Tuten went the other way, limited Wednesday and out Thursday, and he's starting at running back. Jaylen Waddle was full both days. jmello16 has a 26.96-point head start from Stroud, so the line is up to 22.0.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix: Brock Bowers was limited Thursday after sitting Wednesday. With Penix and Love on bye, Catfan94 needs the tight end, and Josh Allen at quarterback. Line up to 40.0 over I Chase Brown Kids.

OBJAY: Geno Smith was limited again and is in the superflex spot. Dalton Kincaid wasn't spotted at practice Thursday. Kraft for Cash already knows Jake Ferguson is out. Hold My DK: Darren Waller upgraded to limited, though he's on the bench. Asian Jim: Kyler Murray missed both days and Ladd McConkey was limited both days, with McConkey in the lineup. Check your Friday reports. Check your lineup for bye weeks. I'm saying that to myself.

stories.title: Four weeks left: Kraft for Cash is 6‑4, and The Champ, Jefferson’s Reserve and Asian Jim are all 5‑5
stories.dek: Six teams make it. The top three are close to locked. The tiebreaker is points for, and TJohn91 has the most of the 5‑5 teams by a lot.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 9‑1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 7‑3. Those three are at least two games clear of seventh place with four weeks to play, so the real fight is for spots four through six between Kraft for Cash at 6‑4 and three teams at 5‑5.

Points for is the tiebreaker. Among the 5‑5 teams: The Champ 1414.72, Jefferson’s Reserve 1253.50, Asian Jim 1191.98. TJohn91 is 161.22 points ahead of jmello16 and 222.74 ahead of ManicOrientals, which is almost two full weeks of scoring. If it's a three-way tie at the end, the two-time champ is in.

I Chase Brown Kids (1219.86) and OBJAY (1184.34) are 4‑6, one game back. Bourbon Lover and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte are 3‑7 and need four straight wins and some help. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10 and mathematically eliminated: seven teams already have five wins, and Br0phy can finish with four at best.

This week's games that matter: Jefferson’s Reserve is a 22.3-point favorite over Bourbon Lover. Kraft for Cash is a 17.0-point favorite over OBJAY now that Geno Smith is Questionable. Catfan94’s Farm Team is a 27.7-point favorite over Asian Jim, with Smith-Njigba on bye. And The Champ gets me, a team whose quarterback depends on Baker Mayfield's ankle, so pencil TJohn91 in for 6‑5.

stories.title: Week 10: Hold My DK beats me by 117.42, Asian Jim steals Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10
stories.dek: Two teams are 9‑1, four teams are fighting over three playoff spots, and I'm 3‑7 with no quarterback for Week 11.
body: Hold My DK 196.34, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 78.92. That's a 117.42-point margin, the biggest of the week and the second-biggest of the season behind Catfan94's 127.22 in Week 5. Christian McCaffrey had 50.3, Patrick Mahomes 45.92, and Derrick Henry added 16.5 on Monday night with two touchdowns on 10 yards rushing. Chuba Hubbard scored 35.7 on the bench. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 9‑1 and has scored 1582.92 points.

The game of the week happened Monday. Kraft for Cash led Asian Jim 89.30 to 84.06 going into Chargers at Ravens, and BTaylor1 had Zay Flowers left against three for ManicOrientals. Flowers scored 9.9. Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown for 19.0, Tre' Harris caught five for 86 (12.6) and Justice Hill added 7.8. Final: Asian Jim 123.46, Kraft for Cash 99.20. ManicOrientals pulled Ladd McConkey for Harris before kickoff, and that move is worth a win. Asian Jim has won three straight and is 5‑5.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Jefferson’s Reserve 232.54 to 134.62, the second-highest score in league history, and is 9‑1 with six straight wins. The Champ beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 166.08 to 68.10; Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards and scored 12.3, and Br0phy is 0‑10. Catfan94’s Farm Team beat OBJAY 138.94 to 83.62, and I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover 124.46 to 116.92 in the closest game of the week.

Bad beat: Jefferson’s Reserve scored 134.62, the fifth-highest score of the week, and lost by 97.92. Low score: Dude, Your Getting a Dell at 68.10. And for the record, I scored 78.92 and started AJ Barner at superflex while Dalton Schultz (8.1) and Samaje Perine (13.9) sat on my bench. Swap those two in and I score 93.12 and lose by 103.22 instead of 117.42. Still the worst week of anyone not named Br0phy.

trades.why: Hold My DK was so short on receivers with Drake London and Cooper Kupp on bye that it picked up Laquon Treadwell and started him. TheMoneyTeam2302 has four quarterbacks. I have one who's on bye and one who needs Mayfield to sit. A 42-year-old backup for a 30-year-old receiver helps two teams with opposite problems.

Daniel Jones scored 4.06 and Kyler Murray missed two more practices. Catfan94 has Josh Allen, Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love and only two quarterback spots to fill. ManicOrientals gets a 28-year-old starter for the stretch run, and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix adds a 25-year-old receiver.

ZachCarroll09 has six quarterbacks and keeps cutting guys to make room. JAY2913 has Bo Nix, a limited Geno Smith and Jaxson Dart on IR. A 24-year-old quarterback for a 24-year-old receiver, which is how dynasty trades should look.

Bourbon Lover is 3‑7 and down 26.96 before Sunday, so paknight12 sells two 31-year-olds. BTaylor1 is 6‑4, trailing OBJAY, with three starters on bye. Contender buys now, rebuilder gets a 22-year-old taxi back and a 25-year-old receiver.
jmello16 has five quarterbacks and starts two. I have a tight end who scored 2.6 on Thursday and keeps getting benched for worse tight ends. Low stakes, both teams get something they'll actually use.

Br0phy leads 10.1 to 0.0 and decides to press the advantage by taking Hold My DK's best player for a backup quarterback. TheMoneyTeam2302 accepts because he's still mad about Treadwell. Nobody would do this.
I give up a 23-year-old and a 22-year-old off my taxi squad for a 33-year-old who is on bye this week. This is how a man starts Drake Maye on a bye. 10‑28 all time is not an accident.

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker didn't fix his quarterback problem. He bought a raffle ticket.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya has seen lottery tickets with better odds than an $11 backup who needs someone else's ankle to cooperate.
body: I'll give the man this: dropping Marquise Brown was right. Brown isn't on an NFL team. You can't play a guy who doesn't have a locker. That's the one thing in this transaction I'd sign off on.

Everything else is hope dressed up as strategy. Jalon Daniels starts for Tampa Bay only if Baker Mayfield's foot and ankle keep him out against Detroit. Daniels went 1-2 in three starts earlier this year. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑7, a 45.0-point underdog, and his quarterback plan depends on another manager's quarterback getting worse. When I played, we didn't pray for the other guy to pull a hamstring. We hit him until he did. Fantasy-wise, I mean.

Meanwhile, Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts and has 28 losses all time. That's the real move. Stop paying $11 for Sunday and start packaging picks for a quarterback who'll be in the lineup in 2027. You're not contending. Act like it. Toughen up.

columns.title: 5 Friday lineup moves from Holden McGroin, who once started a punter at flex 'for field position'
columns.dek: Thursday night is over. Holden McGroin has learned nothing from it and would like to share.
body: 1. Laquon Treadwell scored 0.0, which means he's due. Anybody who scores zero on Thursday is statistically owed points on Sunday. That's the law of averages. I don't know which law, but it's on the books somewhere.

2. Bill_Buttlicker should keep Drake Maye in the lineup. Everyone else in the league benched their bye-week players. When 11 guys zig, the 12th guy zags all the way to 3‑7. You can't argue with that record. I mean you can, it's bad, but you can't argue with it.
3. ManicOrientals, Daniel Jones scored 4.06, so start him again next week. A quarterback who got sacked for a safety is a quarterback who knows where the end zone is. You can't teach that.

4. jmello16, now is the time to spend FAAB. Not because you need anyone. Because you're up 26.96 and you should celebrate. $100 on a kicker. Any kicker. Spend it before it expires. I don't think it expires, but neither do my coupons and I still panic.

5. Br0phy, you're up 10.1 to 0.0. Bench everyone. Lock it in. If no one on Dude, Your Getting a Dell plays, nobody can score less. I've run this play in three different leagues and been kicked out of two of them.

columns.title: Montgomery had 26 carries, Jones had 27 attempts. My model says that makes them the same player.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot went through the Thursday night box score and found patterns nobody asked for.
body: David Montgomery carried 26 times for 107 yards and scored 16.9 for OBJAY. Daniel Jones threw 27 passes for 144 yards and scored 4.06 for Asian Jim. Same volume, within one touch. My conclusion: ManicOrientals rostered the wrong 26-to-27-touch player, and the difference between them is a 12.84-point gap I'm calling the Volume Tax.

C.J. Stroud completed 21 of 27 passes and scored 26.96. Jones also attempted 27 passes. That means Stroud scored 22.90 more points per 27 attempts. jmello16 spent $0 to get Stroud's 26.96. ManicOrientals spent nothing on Jones either, probably. So the value per FAAB dollar is infinite for both, and infinity minus infinity is, per my spreadsheet, Jefferson’s Reserve.

Laquon Treadwell scored 0.0 for Hold My DK and was on the roster for about an hour and a half before kickoff. Tyler Warren scored 3.7 on the taxi squad. That's 3.7 points of taxi-squad efficiency per 0.0 points of started efficiency, which is an undefined ratio, which is the strongest kind of ratio there is.

Finally, Dude, Your Getting a Dell is leading 10.1 to 0.0. Br0phy's season win probability for Week 11 is therefore 100% as of Friday, up from 1% on the line. That's a 99-point increase, the largest in league history, and I'm putting it on a poster.
